skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Explain basic concepts of development planning in a market economy.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Differentiate Centralized vs Market Economy Planning
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Distinguish characteristics of centralized versus market economy planning.
Explain the necessity of planning tools for macroeconomic management by the state.
Analyze contextual factors influencing the selection of planning tools and methods in Vietnam's market economy.
Assess achievements and limitations in organizing and implementing planning activities in Vietnam.
Apply modern planning principles in developing national, sectoral, and local development plans.
Develop the logical framework and basic content of a development plan (national/sector/local).
Create action plans to implement development plans.
Analyze monitoring and evaluation indicators for development plans.
Show professionalism, responsibility, and ethical conduct in implementing and evaluating plans.
Demonstrate teamwork, communication, and presentation skills to present and defend planning results.
